blocks.title: Save. Disconnect. Quit.
blocks.text: Save if possible. Let it finish. Press F2, choose Disconnect, then Proceed. Quit the game. If you have a moment, step somewhere safe first. Quitting may still crash; no fix is proven.
Unsaved progress may be lost. Tell the group later; no recap needed.

sections.title: Join, play, and leave well
sections.intro: Meet up. Adventure together. Leave when you need.

blocks.title: Before your first join
blocks.text: Match the group's collection. Finish Helgen or Helgen Express offline; save outside. Separate campaigns need separate characters.

blocks.title: Join tonight's game
items: Launch Skyrim Together; load your latest campaign save.
Press F2 or Right Ctrl. Choose Connect; use the details the host sent you privately.
Check your party: press F2, click Player Manager, then the Party Menu tab. It lists your party by Name, Lv. and Location. Make sure the leader is there.
Not listed? The leader clicks Launch party in the Party Menu, and you join automatically. Still missing? Look under Invites for "Accept invite from" the leader, or tell the leader.
Go to the spot the host names on Discord. Then open chat with F2 or Right Ctrl, type READY and press Enter.

items.title: Arriving late
items.text: Join the party and regroup. Do not catch up by questing alone.

items.title: Need a minute?
items.text: Type HOLD or BRB. Find safety; menus and chat do not pause danger.

items.title: Something looks wrong
items.text: Stop and tell the host. Never reload while connected or try to fix quests alone. Save before big scenes.

blocks.title: The mods in our game
blocks.note: 19 installed mods, including three foundations. Collection revision 6.
rows: A quick start screen: pick race, sign, gear, spells and helper.
Sortable menus and the Mod Configuration menu.
Menus don't pause. You can be hit while in your bag.
Borderless window, higher frame rates, cursor stays in the game.
Enemies commit to swings, so you can sidestep and punish.
Real weapon hitboxes. Wide swings hit several enemies.
Modern movement. Middle mouse locks onto hostiles; scroll switches target.
Walk up and press E on what's highlighted.
Supports mod settings in the Mod Configuration menu.
One health bar for your current target
Health bars over enemies and a boss bar.
A loot list pops up beside chests and bodies. E takes one, R takes all.
Shows known enchantments, read books, value and weight.
Every school reworked, many new spells. See Spells by school
New powers and passives for every race. See Races
Every perk tree reworked. See Skills
Adds co-op connections, parties, chat and shared quests.
Adds scripting support needed by our mods.
Helps SKSE plugins work with the game.

quickAnswers.label: One leader
quickAnswers.text: Keep the same leader all campaign.

quickAnswers.label: READY
quickAnswers.text: Meet where the host says, then type READY.

sections.title: Make room for specialists
sections.intro: Choose a useful specialty; friends cover your gaps. These are flexible build ideas.

items.title: Healer or paladin
items.text: Restoration first; add personal defense. A paladin swaps between shield, weapon and healing. Give: recovery. Ask: protect my casts. Ordinary robes or steel work; legendary gear can wait.

items.title: Two-handed guardian
items.text: Greatsword, Heavy Armor and Block make space. Turn to protect a chased friend. Give: breathing room. Ask: answer distant casters. No guaranteed taunt; weapon blocking lacks shield-only defenses.

items.title: Stealth ranger
items.text: Archery and Sneak find the opening. Keep moving and shooting after discovery. Give: scouting and focused damage. Ask: a quiet opening, then cover. Start with leather and a bow; sneak bonuses are not guaranteed.

items.title: Gandalf-style wizard
items.text: Destruction and Alteration supply fire and protection; add backup Restoration. Earn a staff later. Give: ranged magic and guidance. Ask: casting space; warn me before scouting. Robes suffice. Extra costume mods need collection approval.

items.title: Gravewarden
items.text: Restoration first, Conjuration second. One conjured helper buys healing time; raising corpses is different. Give: recovery and distraction. Ask: room for the helper. Corpse raising stays quarantined (don't use yet), even in a darker story.

items.title: Storyteller or controller
items.text: Speech, Restoration and a weapon suit a skald; enemy control needs a reliable damage fallback. Give: support and shared decisions. Ask: respect control calls. No promised instruments or buff songs. The quest face remains the fixed leader.

items.title: Keep the role fun
items.text: Keep a fallback. Revisit your specialty after two sessions; discuss major changes so someone still covers healing.

items.title: Not tested yet
items.text: Healing experience, ally perk bonuses, added summons and full combinations are not tested yet. Check installed tooltips and the rules before spending points.

quickAnswers.label: Give and ask
quickAnswers.text: Every role helps and needs help.

sections.title: Make room for everyone
sections.intro: Protect casting space. Finish threats. Give everyone a turn.

blocks.title: One leader per playthrough
blocks.text: Keep one leader for the entire campaign: quest NPCs, scenes, items and entering locations first. Everyone can fight bosses and solve puzzles.

items.title: Pass the story spotlight
items.text: Share story choices without rotating leadership. A different leader needs a separate campaign and characters.

items.title: On me
items.text: A pursuer? Move toward the group; the frontliner intercepts. No permanent aggro promise.

items.title: Healing here
items.text: Come within reach. Healing is not resurrection; wards do not guarantee group protection.

items.title: Caster first
items.text: Focus the named threat. Keep a retreat route open.

blocks.title: Typing counts
blocks.text: F2 or Right Ctrl; click chat, type, then Enter. Ordinary messages are global. Try /party READY or /local Hello. Four-player delivery and readability are not tested yet.

items.title: READY or HOLD
items.text: READY: ready to proceed. HOLD: find safety and wait.

items.title: HELP or BRB
items.text: HELP: help now; give location. BRB: taking a break.

items.title: Wait for typing
items.text: Watch and acknowledge chat. Automatic text-to-speech is not promised.

items.title: Our shared setup
items.text: Use matching mods. Menus stay live. Target lock selects hostiles; aim heals manually. Player friendly fire is off; neutral characters remain vulnerable. Review additions together.

quickAnswers.label: Your turn
quickAnswers.text: Choose together; the leader handles quests.

quickAnswers.label: Live world
quickAnswers.text: Menus and chat do not pause danger.

sections.title: Gear, gold and homes
sections.intro: Your save, pack and gold are personal.

items.title: Gear and loot
items.text: Offer upgrades; leader takes quest items. Stop on missing or duplicate items.

items.title: Gold
items.text: No party purse. Zero percentage death penalty; crime fines still apply.

items.title: Check home storage
items.text: Recognized vanilla/DLC home chests should stay local. Test yours with a cheap item, save and rejoin. Privacy and permanence aren't guaranteed. Your friend's chest isn't a delivery box.

items.title: Meeting place, not bank
items.text: Shared containers aren't permanent banks. Check guild, outdoor and modded storage separately. Empty rooms before renovations replace containers.

blocks.title: Try a small hand-off
items: Choose an unowned container outside a home; start with one cheap item.
Donor uses the full menu, deposits, then closes it.
Recipient opens the full menu and takes the agreed item.
Both check packs. Stop if counts disagree.
Save and check again after reconnecting.

blocks.title: Trading is not tested yet
blocks.text: One person at a time. Never trade floor drops. Gold, crafted items and QuickLoot transfers are not tested yet.

items.title: Buy a city home
items.text: Leader completes prerequisites; buy from the steward. Budget furnishings separately. Never repeat quests alone.

items.title: Build with Hearthfire
items.text: Hearthfire land: 5,000 gold before building. Draft layouts, then use the carpenter's bench. Shared construction is not tested yet.

items.title: Check each character
items.text: Nonleader payments, keys, access and furnishings are not tested yet. Promise neither one shared purchase nor four required payments.

items.title: Proposed: personal belongings
items.text: Proposed, not accepted: our agreement, not the game's rules. Personal gear and gold; no spawning, duplication or reload-farming. Offer upgrades, alternate ties; no leader bonus. Leader handles quest NPCs and items.

items.title: Proposed: shared responsibilities
items.text: Voluntary shared costs; pledges aren't payments. Name supply holders. Test personal storage. Earn homes; agree buyer and guests. Protect absent players' belongings and story.

items.title: Make the company yours
items.text: Optional crafting roles or home goals. Mark supplies pledged, held or spent.

items.title: Not tested yet
items.text: Family systems, horse ownership after reconnecting and custom-item supply chains.

quickAnswers.label: Personal
quickAnswers.text: Your save, your gear, your gold.

quickAnswers.label: Home chest
quickAnswers.text: Test your exact chest before storing valuables.
